name: Neutrophils (%)
rangeNote: The absolute neutrophil count (cells per litre) is often more useful than the percentage.
summary: Neutrophils are the most common white blood cells and the first to respond to bacterial infections. This value is their share of all white cells.

high.meaning: A higher share of neutrophils is common with bacterial infections, stress, intense exercise or steroid medicines.

low.meaning: A lower share is common during viral infections, when lymphocytes rise. Some healthy people naturally have lower neutrophil counts.
commonCauses: Natural variation, more common in people of African or Middle Eastern descent
